free_tier.stated: The cheapest whole-card hour recorded: an RTX 3090 24GB at USD 0.09 per GPU-hour on the community tier, an RTX 4090 24GB at USD 0.16, an RTX 5090 32GB at USD 0.25 and an L40S 48GB at USD 0.79, checked 2026-10-22. These are interruptible community nodes, which the vendor's own pricing page prices by priority tier, with medium and high priority priced above the lowest tier.

retention.stated: Community nodes are the lowest priority tier and are preempted by higher-priority workloads, so a job that must run to completion cannot rely on holding the card.

chaining: At USD 0.09 a 3090-hour, USD 10 buys 111 hours on a 24 GB card, which is the cheapest way to run a long checkpointed fine-tune; the preemption risk is what the discount pays for.
